verdict.rationale: There is no llms.txt or markdown docs endpoint: probes returned HTTP 404 for /llms.txt and /docs.md. However, Elastic's docs offer official skills that teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch and the wider Elastic stack, which is a form of agent-oriented documentation. missing for 10: an llms.txt index, machine-readable markdown docs endpoints, detail on what the agent skills cover and how they are consumed, and independent hands-on corroboration.
